title: Best OP Auto Steal Egg Auto Feed Auto Hatch Auto Sell Pets
features:
Ronix Hub - Ride A Pet

Feeding
- Auto feed your pets on a delay you set
- Food modes for highest XP, lowest XP, a specific food, or whatever is equipped
- Target the pets you want, all of them, lowest weight, lowest age, or one you pick
- Auto equip food, auto re-equip your tool, and mute the eating sound

Pets
- Auto place pets from your inventory on a delay you set
- Place all of them, highest weight, lowest weight, or one you pick
- Auto ride the nearest pet, with a ride speed boost you control
- Mount, dismount, or mount a pet you choose
- Teleport to your ranch

Stealing
- Auto steal eggs with sky tween, tween, or teleport
- Set your own travel speed and a faster return speed
- Returns to your plot on its own once the egg is yours
- Anti break egg, teleports you out when the break timer gets unsafe
- Filter by all spawned eggs, unclaimed only, or a specific egg
- Egg ESP with highlights, tags, and distance

Eggs
- Auto place eggs from your inventory into the nest
- Auto hatch on a delay, or hatch everything ready right now
- Auto equip the egg tool

Selling
- Auto sell pets at Richie on an interval you set
- Sell when the ranch is full, when your inventory fills, or both
- Teleports to Richie and puts you back where you were
- Master farm sequence loops hatch, place, and sell for you

Shop
- Auto buy shop items on a delay you set
- Keep a minimum cash reserve untouched
- Pick the food and gear you actually want
- Refresh the stock on demand

Status
- Live monitors for feeding, ranch space, riding, stealing, hatching, shop, and session

Player
- Anti AFK, beats the 20 minute idle kick
- Walk speed, jump power, infinite jump, noclip, and fullbright
- Watermark HUD with ping, totals, and a hide key

Ronix WindUI, mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
